pages.alt: Tiffin the otter, in a red number 7 football kit, waves on a sunny football pitch next to a goal. A big yellow banner says “Goal, {name}”.

text: Tiffin has boots. Tiffin has a ball.
pages.prompt: Lift the flap on the kit bag!
pages.alt: Tiffin, in her red kit, hugs a football and waves a boot. A red kit bag with a flap sits on a bench.
pages.altAfter: Tiffin hugs a football and waves a boot. Out of the red kit bag {pops a red number 1 shirt|pop red number 1 shirts} with {name} on the back.

pages.prompt: Turn the wheel, round and round!
pages.alt: Tiffin warms up inside a big golden wheel on the pitch. The bunting above spells {name}.
pages.altAfter: Tiffin jumps for joy inside the big golden wheel. The bunting above spells {name}.

pages.prompt: Slide the ball across... and back again!
pages.alt: Kick-off! Tiffin kicks the ball along a path across the pitch. In the stand, the crowd holds up a banner that says “Go! {name}”.

pages.prompt: Pull the tab! Dive, Tiffin, dive!
pages.alt: Goose, in a blue number 9 kit, shoots at the goal and Tiffin dives to save it. The scoreboard says {name} 0, Blues 0.
pages.altAfter: Boing! Tiffin catches the ball in her big yellow gloves. The scoreboard says {name} 0, Blues 0.

pages.prompt: Push the ball into the net, {name}!
pages.alt: Frog, in goal, dives the wrong way while Tiffin waits with her arms up. The ball is ready to go into the net. The scoreboard says {name} 0, Blues 0.
pages.altAfter: Goal! The ball is in the net, and Tiffin cheers. The scoreboard says {name} 1, Blues 0.

pages.prompt: Lift the flap to find the prize!
after: A big gold cup! Well done, Tiffin! Well done, {name}!
pages.alt: Full time! Tiffin jumps for joy with Goose and Frog. A red cloth covers something on a white podium, and the crowd holds up a banner that says “Go! {name}”.
pages.altAfter: A shiny gold cup stands on the podium, with {name} on its plaque. Confetti falls and everyone cheers.

text: Home we go. Boots off. Lights low.
Tip... tap... off to sleep we go.
Paw in hand, side by side.
pages.alt: Night time. Tiffin sleeps in her basket under a starry blanket. {name's} red number 1 shirt, with {name} on the back, hangs on a chair by the lamp, and the gold cup sits on the windowsill.
